bls_geographies.comment: Reference table mapping BLS geography codes to FIPS codes, CBSA codes, and Census regions

nipa_tables.comment: Reference dimension table for NIPA table classifications and descriptions. PK is table_name alone — the former section categorization named in an earlier PK here was never populated and the partition column was renamed section->type in commit a2c400aaa, so the table no longer has a section column (see the columns block above and national_accounts_enriched's comment in econ-schema.yaml). table_name unique is a correctness fact about this table, not a query-planner lever: national_accounts_enriched's LEFT JOIN against it can't be skipped based on that uniqueness, and skipping it would only drop this table's own small scan anyway — table_id is sourced from national_accounts, the large side of that join, not from here. Discovering table_id values cheaply means querying national_accounts_tables directly, not DISTINCT-ing through national_accounts_enriched.

regional_linecodes.comment: Reference dimension table for BEA Regional table LineCode classifications and descriptions. Composite key includes partition columns (type, tablename) and LineCode data column.

naics_sectors.comment: Reference dimension table for NAICS supersector industry classifications. PK is supersector_code alone; the 'type' partition column is a constant physical discriminator ('naics_sectors') and carries no identity, so it is excluded from the logical key. This lets state_industry/metro_industry FKs reference the real primary key rather than a PK subset.

partitionedTables.name: jolts_industries
partitionedTables.comment: JOLTS industry code reference table from BLS. Maps industry codes to human-readable industry names for JOLTS data (jolts_regional, jolts_state tables). Essential dimension table for decoding JOLTS industry classifications.

columns.name: industry_code
columns.comment: JOLTS industry code

columns.name: industry_name
columns.comment: Industry name

partitionedTables.name: jolts_dataelements

ftpFiles.comment: JOLTS data element code reference file

partitionedTables.comment: JOLTS data element code reference table from BLS. Maps metric codes (JOR, HIR, QUR, TSR, LDR) to descriptions (Job Openings Rate, Hires Rate, etc.). Essential dimension table for understanding JOLTS metrics in jolts_regional and jolts_state tables.

columns.name: dataelement_code
columns.comment: JOLTS data element code

columns.name: dataelement_text
columns.comment: Data element description

partitionedTables.name: bls_geographies
partitionedTables.comment: BLS geography reference table mapping state abbreviations to FIPS codes, census regions, metro areas, and BLS-specific area codes. Consolidates STATE_FIPS_MAP, CENSUS_REGIONS, METRO_AREA_CODES, METRO_CPI_CODES, and METRO_BLS_AREA_CODES into a single catalog-driven table. Enables dynamic geography lookups without hardcoded maps.

columns.name: geo_code
columns.comment: Primary geography code (state abbreviation, metro code like 'A100', or region code)

columns.name: geo_name
columns.comment: Geography name (e.g., 'California', 'New York-Newark-Jersey City, NY-NJ-PA', 'Northeast')

columns.name: geo_type
columns.comment: Geography type: 'state', 'metro', 'region'

columns.name: state_fips
columns.comment: 2-digit state FIPS code (e.g., '06' for CA, '36' for NY). NULL for regions.

columns.name: region_code
columns.comment: 4-digit census region code for regions (e.g., '0100' for Northeast). NULL for states/metros.

columns.name: metro_publication_code
columns.comment: BLS publication code for metro areas (e.g., 'A100' for NYC). NULL for states/regions.

columns.name: metro_cpi_area_code
columns.comment: CPI area code for metro CPI series (e.g., 'S35D' for NYC). NULL if metro lacks CPI data or for states/regions.

columns.name: metro_bls_area_code
columns.comment: 7-digit BLS area code for metro employment series (state FIPS + 5-digit area code, e.g., '3693561' for NYC). NULL for states/regions.

columns.name: cbsa_code
columns.comment: 5-digit OMB Core Based Statistical Area code (e.g., '35620' for NYC). NULL for states/regions. Enables joins to geo.cbsa for geographic boundaries.

partitionedTables.name: naics_sectors
partitionedTables.comment: BLS NAICS supersector reference table mapping supersector codes to industry names. Consolidates NAICS_SUPERSECTORS hardcoded map. Used for state_industry_employment, metro_industry_employment, and other industry-based BLS series.

columns.name: supersector_code
columns.comment: 8-digit NAICS supersector code (e.g., '00000000' for total nonfarm, '05000000' for construction)

columns.name: supersector_name
columns.comment: Industry supersector name (e.g., 'Total Nonfarm', 'Construction', 'Manufacturing')

partitionedTables.name: nipa_tables
partitionedTables.comment: BEA NIPA (National Income and Product Accounts) table reference catalog: maps each NIPA table_name code (e.g., 'T10105', 'T20100') to its BEA description. Static lookup only (table_name, description columns, no year/time dimension), downloaded early to enable dynamic discovery of available NIPA tables before the main NIPA data pull.

columns.name: table_name
columns.comment: NIPA table code (e.g., 'T10105', 'T20100')

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Full table description from BEA including frequency indicators (A, Q)

partitionedTables.name: regional_linecodes
partitionedTables.comment: BEA Regional dataset LineCode catalog. Maps table-specific line codes (key) to their descriptions (desc) for the 56 tracked BEA Regional tables (SAINC*, SQINC*, CAINC*, SAGDP*, SQGDP*, CAGDP* series). Each Regional table has its own set of valid LineCodes, so this catalog is fetched first (one API call per tablename) to enable complete regional data collection without hardcoded LineCode limitations.

columns.name: key
columns.comment: Line code identifier from BEA API (e.g., '10', '20', '30')

columns.name: desc
columns.comment: Line code description from BEA API (e.g., 'Personal income', 'Compensation of employees')

partitionedTables.name: fred_series
partitionedTables.comment: FRED series discovery/metadata catalog: series id, title, observation date range (observation_start/observation_end), frequency, units, seasonal adjustment, last-updated timestamp, and popularity scores — one row per series, partitioned by category (7 top-level FRED categories: Production & Business Activity, Population/Employment/Labor Markets, National Accounts, Prices, Discontinued/Legacy, Money/Banking/Finance, International Data; up to 1000 series fetched per category). This is a lookup/discovery catalog only, not observation data — see econ.fred_indicators for the curated ~48-series time series values (enumerated in that table's series column comment).

columns.name: series
columns.comment: Unique FRED series identifier (e.g. 'UNRATE', 'GDP'). This is the catalog of everything FRED publishes, so use it to decode or discover series; the econ.fred_indicators observations table loads only a curated 48-series subset, enumerated in that table's series column comment.

columns.name: title
columns.comment: Full descriptive title of the economic data series

columns.name: observation_start
columns.comment: Date of first available observation (ISO 8601 format)

columns.name: observation_end
columns.comment: Date of most recent observation (ISO 8601 format)

columns.name: frequency
columns.comment: Data frequency (e.g., 'Daily', 'Monthly', 'Quarterly', 'Annual')

columns.name: frequency_short
columns.comment: Abbreviated frequency code (e.g., 'D', 'M', 'Q', 'A')

columns.name: units
columns.comment: Units of measurement (e.g., 'Percent', 'Billions of Dollars')

columns.name: units_short
columns.comment: Abbreviated units code

columns.name: seasonal_adjustment
columns.comment: Seasonal adjustment status (e.g., 'Seasonally Adjusted', 'Not Seasonally Adjusted')

columns.name: seasonal_adjustment_short
columns.comment: Abbreviated seasonal adjustment code (e.g., 'SA', 'NSA')

columns.name: last_updated
columns.comment: Timestamp of last data update (ISO 8601 format)

columns.name: popularity
columns.comment: FRED popularity score indicating usage/interest level

columns.name: group_popularity
columns.comment: Popularity score within category group

columns.name: notes
columns.comment: Detailed description, methodology, and source information

operands.comment: Reference and dimension tables for U.S. economic data. Contains lookup tables for BLS series codes, geographic mappings, industry classifications, and metadata catalogs for FRED, NIPA, and BEA Regional datasets. These tables should be loaded before the main econ schema as they provide dimension data for enriched views and semantic queries.
